run_search_demo: run the mctx search algorithm on a toy environment and output the selected action with its Q-value
convert_tree_to_graph: convert a mctx search tree into a directed Graphviz graph with node and edge labels
make_batched_env_model: build a batched environment model with transition matrix, rewards, and prior logits for mctx search
visualize_search_tree: visualize a search tree as a Graphviz diagram saved to a PNG file
run_mctx_gumbel_policy: run gumbel-MuZero policy search with configurable simulations and max depth
